log_format: Append-only. One row per observation of one stay, never an overwrite of a previous row. Each row records the room rate, the same-stay checkout total, the nightly average, the mandatory resort fee and tax, parking, the cancellation deadline, occupancy and the rate timestamp, each with its own verification flag.
comparison_rule: Compare like for like: same check-in and check-out dates, same occupancy, same room type, and the same resort-fee and tax treatment. Rows whose check-in and check-out dates are blank cannot be compared on rate and are shown for their fee terms only.

entries.room_rate_note: No official dated room rate was confirmable. Every official booking engine on these properties is a JavaScript application that returns no static rate table to a plain fetch, and no resort publishes a rate card. Left blank rather than inferred.
entries.tax_note: Official Venetian hotel terms: "Daily rates do not include the applicable Clark County Room Tax of 13.38%." Confirmed for the same rate by the official Clark County transient lodging licence list.
entries.parking_note: Official Venetian hotel terms: "The daily fee for registered hotel guests is $20/day, seven days a week. For non-hotel guests, the fee is $20, Monday - Thursday, and $25/day Friday - Sunday. Valet parking is $40/day."
entries.cancellation_note: The official terms bill a deposit at reservation confirmation but do not publish a single cancellation deadline; the deadline depends on the booked offer. Left unverified.
entries.rate_timestamp_note: Timestamp of the read of the official fee, tax, parking and cancellation terms that this row records. No dated room rate was observed on that date.
